subject: System Design
title: Vertical vs Horizontal Scaling
description: Learn Vertical vs Horizontal Scaling in one minute.

hook.text: Your server is maxed out. Do you buy a bigger machine or add more machines?

buildup.text: Vertical scaling means upgrading to a more powerful server. Horizontal scaling means adding more servers.

discovery.text: Vertical is simpler but has a ceiling — the biggest machine in the world still has limits.

twist.text: Horizontal scaling is theoretically unlimited but requires load balancing, data partitioning, and coordination.

climax.text: Most large systems use both: scale up as far as practical, then scale out.

punchline.text: Scale up until you can't, then scale out.

quiz.question: What is horizontal scaling?
options: Adding more servers to handle load
Upgrading to a more powerful server
Adding more RAM to one machine
